segments.name: Gene therapy
segments.description: Develops AAV-based gene therapies for the treatment of rare monogenic diseases of the central nervous system.
segments.evidence: The Company views its operations and manages its business as a single operating segment, the gene therapy segment, which is the business of developing AAV-based gene therapies for the treatment of rare monogenic diseases of the central nervous system.

revenueModel.text: The company derives revenue solely from the Astellas Agreements, which include an exclusive option to license intellectual property and performance of research and development activities.
revenueModel.evidence: The gene therapy segment derives revenue solely from the Astellas Agreements (see Note 7).
